queries.purpose: Refresh optimize-stage evidence for replacing zero-filled late GPU block-cache allocation with uninitialized allocation only when every cache slot is written by WaveBuffer admission before any cache-hit read.
queries.query: Official PyTorch documentation for torch.empty uninitialized tensor allocation on CUDA versus torch.zeros, deterministic fill_uninitialized_memory behavior, and safety requirements when tensors are fully written before read.

queries.purpose: Confirm official torch.empty, torch.zeros, and uninitialized-memory determinism semantics.
queries.query: Fetch official PyTorch torch.empty, torch.zeros, and reproducibility notes for filling uninitialized memory.

material_updates.action: Evaluate an opt-in torch.empty allocation policy only for forced-late GPU block-cache K/V tensors.
material_updates.finding: PyTorch documents torch.empty as returning uninitialized data, while torch.zeros returns scalar-zero-filled tensors. PyTorch also documents that using uninitialized memory as input is invalid; it is performance-motivated only when the program is valid and does not read uninitialized memory.
material_updates.impact: The candidate must remain default-off, must keep unset/default zero-filled behavior, and must restrict uninitialized allocation to cache_keys/cache_values allocated in prepare_cache() after prefill. The safety argument depends on WaveBufferCPU descriptors initializing clusters as misses and setting inBlockCache only when gather_copy_and_scatter writes admitted blocks.

material_updates.action: Keep opt012 as the memory/throughput reference stack.
material_updates.finding: opt012 preserved opt010-like block cache and peak process GPU memory (5673.0 MiB block cache, 29884 MiB peak) while improving decode throughput versus opt010 through pinned side-stream late metadata migration.
material_updates.impact: The opt013 measurement should reuse the opt012 environment and compare against research/BASELINE_RESULT.json plus opt010/opt011/opt012 artifacts without rerunning the healthy baseline.

decision_impact: Proceed with a Python-only, default-off late block-cache init policy. Retain the idea only if two real-hardware rounds preserve correctness and opt012-like memory while improving e2e or decode throughput; otherwise mark it refuted or inconclusive without claiming a speedup from allocation semantics alone.
